TC-13/S02.title: Paste a prior note on a Hospital chart: live extraction updates the chart and takes no vitals
TC-13/S02.detail: Dev, live Haiku (3.3 s). Before: no note/imaging/background. After Save & Extract: 'Note · Oct 11' saved once (source explicit-import), CXR effusions + TTE + renal US on Diagnostic Testing, background + issues on Hospital Course, no 142/88 / 38.4 anywhere (page, editor, vitals, IPs, stored extraction), physician's IP kept, no issue written into Important Points (Q2 now: issues are bullets under the background). Prior labs in the new 'Prior Note Labs' panel dated 'Prior note · Oct 11'.
